 Versus

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Tiwari

Present : Mr. B.S. Saroha, Advocate
 for the petitioner.
 Mr. Bhupender Singh, Dag, Haryana.

Kuldeep Tiwari. J.(Oral)
1.

On 24.06.2024, a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court had passed the hereinafter extracted order,
upon the instant petition:-
"Instant petition has been filed under Section 438, Cr.P.C., for grant of anticipatory
bail in:-
Fir No. Dated Police Station Sections(s) 101 26.05.2024 City Safidon 18(c) & 27 of
District Jind The Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 and Sections 336, 420 Ipc, Sections
3, 4 and 5 of Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act, 1971 and Section 34 of The

1

Besides making a reference to the affidavit of patient, Smt.Praveen Kumari, Annexure P4, counsel for the petitioner has placed reliance upon interim order dated 12.06.2024, Annexure P7 whereby co-accused, Seema, has been granted interim protection by this Court.
He submits that there is no allegation of terminating the pregnancy against the petitioner and he has been named as an accused because he is owner of Anuj Multispeciality Hospital.
He submits that the petitioner is prepared to join the investigation and cooperate with the investigating agency.
Notice of motion.
On asking of the Court, Mr.Aman Bahri, Addl.A.G., Haryana, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent - State.
To be heard with CRM-M-29692-2024.

Petitioner is directed to appear before the Investigating Officer on 01.07.2024 at 10:00 A.M. at Police Station City Safidon, District Jind, and join the investigation and appear as and when called by the Investigating Officer.

entities.text: Police Station City Safidon, District Jind
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In the event of arrest, he shall be admitted to interim bail on furnishing personal and surety bonds to the satisfaction of Arresting/Investigating Officer.

He shall also abide by the conditions as specified under Section 438(2) Cr.P.C."
2.
Status report by way of affidavit dated 14.07.2024 of Sh. Rohtash Singh, Deputy Superintendent of Polie, Jind-Law and Order, District Jind has been filed on behalf of respondent-State.
The same is taken on record.
Copy of the same has been supplied to the opposite counsel.

3. Today, the learned State counsel on instructions imparted to him by PSI Pardeep, submits that the petitioner has already joined the investigation and he is fully co-operating with the investigation process and he is not required for any further custodial interrogation.

4. In view of the specific stand taken by the learned State counsel, the present petition is allowed and order dated 24.06.2024 is, hereby, made absolute subject to 2 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:087465 CRM-M-30394-2024 - 3- the condition that the petitioner shall abide by the conditions as envisaged under Section 438(2)
Cr.P.C.
 (KULDEEP TIWARI)
15.07.2024 JUDGE amandeep
